title: Timer
description: On-delay, off-delay or pulse timer (plus inverted). ENO is the timer's output Q, held as a level; Elapsed counts in time_base units.

in.title: Start
in.description: The signal the timer acts on; the block's enable gates the whole timer.

eno.title: Q
eno.description: The timer's output level: true after the on-delay, during a pulse, or until the off-delay ends. Put it on another block's Run when to gate that block.
